G1_unambiguity.justification: The band restriction and product-equals-two condition unambiguously require every listed pair to receive different bands.

G2_completeness.justification: The rewrite includes the necessary constraints, input format, output format, lexicographic tie-break rule, and examples.

G3_faithfulness.justification: With band values restricted to 1 and 2, requiring product 2 is exactly equivalent to requiring each conflicting pair to use different shifts.

G4_naturalness.justification: The scenario is coherent and readable, although expressing the ordinary two-coloring constraint through signal products feels somewhat contrived.
